direction: Create a sleek, modern isometric tech illustration with soft volumetric lighting and gentle ocean mist. Use only the brand hues—tide teal (#0e7490), deep sea blue (#164e63), and sea foam (#ecfeff)—with neutrals for balance. Mood is calm, reliable, and “always in sync,” avoiding clutter. Composition should feel clean and engineered: crisp edges, subtle gradients, and light reflections like water on metal. No text, letters, logos, or watermarks anywhere.

slots.alt: tidewater: watch a folder, sync it to any S3 bucket
slots.subject: folder-to-S3 sync flow
slots.prompt: folder-to-S3 sync flow in an isometric view: a small open folder icon on the left sending glowing data packets along a curved cable of sea-foam light toward a distant simplified S3 bucket-like container on the right (no text). A soft tide-teal glow pulse travels across the path, implying resumable uploads. Background: dark deep-sea blue with faint ocean-mist gradient. Leave the entire center area clean for clear focal framing, no text or symbols. Cinematic lighting, crisp edges.

slots.alt: tidewater: watch a folder, sync it to any S3 bucket
slots.subject: watcher syncing uploads
slots.prompt: watcher syncing uploads as a minimalist isometric scene: a command console-shaped slab (generic, no letters) sits above a folder platform, with several file blocks sliding onto a transfer arc and landing into a bucket-like container (no text). Indicate “resumable” via a dotted partial transfer trail that continues smoothly from a break point. Use tide teal and deep sea blue with sea-foam highlights for the moving elements. Background is a smooth gradient ocean haze. Keep composition balanced with generous empty space near the edges; no text or logos.

slots.alt: An empty harbour at low tide
slots.subject: empty harbour at low tide
slots.prompt: empty harbour at low tide, wide isometric landscape: still water receding to reveal wet sand and exposed wooden pilings, with gentle sea-foam streaks and reflective puddles. Subtle tide-teal light wraps the scene from the horizon; deep sea blue sky with faint mist bands. In the foreground, a single quiet dock walkway leads toward the waterline, suggesting “nothing changed.” No people, no buildings with signage, no text, no symbols. Natural calm lighting, high clarity, minimal clutter.

about: tidewater is a command-line tool: it watches a folder and keeps it in sync with an S3 bucket. One binary, no daemon, resumable uploads. Its colours are tide teal, deep sea blue and sea foam.
